violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: Observed a spray bottle of clear liquid being stored on a food preparation table. Upon discussion with PIC, the liquid in the spray bottle is water for pretzels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO LABEL THE SPRAY BOTTLE AS “WATER”

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) turkey; 2) Korean sauce; and 3) meat sauce all from the walk in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE EXPIRED FOODS.
